title: First Atomic Weapons
description: The United States successfully tests and deploys atomic weapons, marking the beginning of the nuclear age and divergence from our timeline.

title: Transistor Never Invented
description: Unlike our timeline, the transistor is never invented, leading to a continued reliance on vacuum tubes and a distinctive retro-futuristic aesthetic.

title: Fusion Power Achieved
description: Scientists achieve practical fusion power, revolutionizing energy production but leading to conflicts over remaining oil reserves.

title: Power Armor Development
description: The first T-45d Power Armor is deployed by the United States military, changing warfare forever.

title: The Great War
description: On October 23, 2077, nuclear war erupts. In two hours, most of the world is reduced to cinders. The lucky ones died instantly.

title: Vault 13 Opens
description: The Vault Dweller emerges from Vault 13 to find a water chip, ultimately defeating the Master and the Unity.

title: NCR Founded
description: The New California Republic is officially founded, becoming one of the largest post-war nations.

title: Brotherhood of Steel Founded
description: Captain Roger Maxson leads a revolt at Mariposa Military Base, eventually founding the Brotherhood of Steel.

title: The Institute Formed
description: Survivors of CIT (Commonwealth Institute of Technology) retreat underground, eventually becoming the Institute.

title: Enclave Emerges
description: The Enclave, remnants of the pre-war government, reveal themselves on the West Coast.
